verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਅਉਚਰ ਚਰਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal khaavanaa dhukh sukh sam kar aauchar charanaa|

en.bdb: Adopting pleasure and pain equally, the gurmukhs eat the fruit of delight.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਗਾਵਣਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਝਰੁ ਝਰਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhee dhaa gaavanaa a(n)mirat baanee nijhar jharanaa|

en.bdb: Music in the Sikh way of life is the continuous flow (singing) of ambrosial hymns of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhee dheeraj dharam piram piaalaa ajar jaranaa|

en.bdb: Fortitude and duty in Sikh life is the bearing of the unbearable power of the cup of love.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਡਰਿ ਨਿਡਰੁ ਨਿਡਰਿ ਮੁਚ ਡਰਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhee dhaa sa(n)jamo ddar niddar niddar much ddaranaa|

en.bdb: The practice of continence in Sikhism is getting fearless in this scaring world and moving always in the fear of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhee mil saadhasa(n)g sabadh surat jag dhutar taranaa|

en.bdb: Another doctrine of the Sikh life is that joining the holy congregation and concentrating the mind in the word, man goes across the world ocean.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਏਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਫੁਰਮਾਏ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਕਰਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhee dhaa karam eh gur furamaae gursikh karanaa|

en.bdb: Acting according the instructions of the Guru is the performance of the Sikh life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit_en: gur kirapaa gur sikh gur saranaa ||10||

en.bdb: By the grace of the Guru, the disciple (Sikh) remains in the shelter of the Guru.
